purpose: Teach: 下方/私鉄/郵貯/竣工/インサイド/四方/ロイター/パーフェクト

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検挙数の下方修正もご公表ですね
lines.en: The police have also made a downward revision on arrest numbers, haven't they?
lines.style: Conversational, acknowledging tone. Light, expectant lift on the question—not demanding confirmation but inviting it. Warm, collegial pace. Like someone pointing out a shared observation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、私鉄の駅警備もされますね
lines.en: The police also provide security at private railway stations, don't they?
lines.style: Same warm, collaborative tone. Steady delivery, genuinely curious. A tick of interest in the voice—noticing something about the scope of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、郵貯詐欺事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police handle postal fraud cases too, I imagine?
lines.style: Continuing the same gentle inquiry. Slightly more tentative on this one—acknowledging he's asking about specifics. Respectful, not testing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新庁舎の竣工式を警備されますね
lines.en: You provided security for the opening ceremony of the new headquarters, right?
lines.style: Interest picking up slightly. Still conversational but with a note of genuine appreciation for the operational work involved. Light curiosity on the ceremony detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織のインサイド情報を集められますね
lines.en: You also gather inside intelligence on criminal organizations, I imagine?
lines.style: Tone shifts subtly—moving into more sensitive territory. Still warm, but with a thread of respect for the work's gravity. Careful enunciation. Slightly lower in the register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、四方からの警備網を整備されますね
lines.en: You've also established security networks from all sides, haven't you?
lines.style: Back to collaborative tone. Appreciative note—acknowledging the scale of coordination. Steady, admiring pace. Like noting something both comprehensive and impressive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ロイター速報を分析されますね
lines.en: You analyze Reuters reports as well, don't you?
lines.style: Lighter touch returning. Noticing one more dimension of the work—almost with a hint of wry recognition at how much ground they cover. Quick, conversational.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警備をパーフェクトに進められますね
lines.en: And you execute this security work flawlessly, I see.
lines.style: Tone solidifies into genuine respect and admiration. Slower, more measured. Weight behind the words—not ironic, sincere. Final observation delivered with quiet conviction.
